detail.longDescription:
Mirror iPhone to Smart TV & Cast Videos, Photos, Web to the Big Screen

Best for:
- Watching movies and series on TV
- Streaming anime and web videos
- Mirroring iPhone screen for presentations
- Sharing photos and videos with family
- Using Live Camera as a baby monitor

Use this app to:
- Mirror your iPhone screen to any Smart TV
- Cast videos from websites (like anime or streams) directly to TV
- Watch YouTube on the big screen with the built-in web caster
- Stream movies and photos from your phone gallery
- Turn your iPhone into a Live Camera for nanny streaming or events

Overview
Screen Mirroring | Cast to TV is the simple, reliable way to share your iPhone screen with your television. Whether you want to mirror your display for a presentation, cast a video from the web, or stream a movie to a Samsung TV, this app makes it easy. It supports all major devices, including Roku, LG, Chromecast, Amazon Fire TV, and Samsung Smart TVs.

How to Mirror iPhone to TV
- Open the app and tap "Connect TV."
- Tap "Allow" for the local network access request.
- Ensure your iPhone and Smart TV are on the same Wi-Fi network.
- Wait for your TV (e.g., Samsung, Roku) to appear in the list.
- Select your TV to establish the connection.
- If needed, confirm the connection on your TV screen (e.g., select "Yes" or "Allow").

Key Features
Screen Mirroring
- Mirror your entire iPhone screen to your TV. Ideal for gaming, showing presentations, or just browsing the web on a larger display.

Web Video Caster
- Cast videos from almost any website directly to your TV. Use this feature to watch content that isn't available on standard apps, including web series, news, or anime.

Photo & Video Casting
- Instantly share your photo gallery and home videos on the big screen. It's perfect for reliving memories with friends and family in cinema-like quality.

Live Camera
- Turn your iPhone into a live camera. Stream real-time video to your TV, perfect for use as a video baby monitor, broadcasting family gatherings, or conducting live sessions.

AI Movie Advisor
- Get personalized movie and series recommendations tailored to your taste. Never struggle to find something great to watch again.

Compatibility
- Works seamlessly with all popular devices: Samsung Smart TVs, Roku, LG Smart TVs, Amazon Fire TV, Chromecast, Vizio, and more.

FAQ
Q: Can I mirror my iPhone to a Samsung TV?
A: Yes. The app fully supports screen mirroring to Samsung Smart TVs and many other devices when connected to the same Wi-Fi network.
Q: Does it work with Roku?
A: Yes. Screen Mirroring | Cast to TV is compatible with Roku players and Roku TVs.
Q: Can I cast videos from websites like YouTube or streaming sites?
A: Absolutely. The built-in Web Video Caster allows you to cast videos from YouTube and thousands of other websites directly to your TV.
Q: Is the app free?
A: The app offers core features for free. Advanced features and an ad-free experience are available via subscription.
Q: Does it work offline?
A: The app requires a Wi-Fi connection to connect to your TV. However, you can cast photos and videos saved locally on your device.

Subscription Information
Subscriptions are billed to your iTunes Account upon purchase confirmation. Autorenewal ensures uninterrupted service unless disabled at least 24 hours before the current billing cycle ends. Manage your subscriptions in your Account Settings.
